Class RegularGridIntegrationTests

java.lang.Object
geometries.impl.RegularGridIntegrationTests
class RegularGridIntegrationTests extends Object
Integration tests for Regular Grid acceleration. Tests verify that rendering with and without the grid produces identical results.
